enableCustomReinf.name: Enable Custom Reinforcement Messages
enableCustomReinf.description: Toggles the custom reinforcement messages. If disabled, the default reinforcement messages will be used.

CustomReinf.name: Reinforcement Message
CustomReinf.description:
Placeholders:
%player% = Player name
%location% = Location
%distance% = Distance
Leave empty to use the default design.

testReinf.name: Send Test Message
testReinf.description: Sends a preview of the reinforcement message into your chat (client-sided).

CustomReinfAccept.name: Reinforcement Accept Message
CustomReinfAccept.description: Sends a preview of the reinforcement accept message into your chat (client-sided).

testReinfAccept.name: Send Test Accept Message
testReinfAccept.description: Sends a preview of the reinforcement Accept message into your chat (client-sided).

factionMemberColor.name: Faction Member Colors
factionMemberColor.description: Highlights the members of your faction by coloring their nametags.

enableFactionMemberColor.name: Enable Colored Nametags
enableFactionMemberColor.description: Toggles colored nametags for faction members.

color.name: Color
color.description: Select the color for the nametags.

enableAllianceMemberColor.name: Enable Alliance Colored Nametags
enableAllianceMemberColor.description: Toggles colored nametags for alliance members.

allianceColor.name: Alliance Color
allianceColor.description: Select the color for the alliance nametags.

subtitle.name: Nametag Subtitle
subtitle.description: Customize the subtitle shown below your own name only. You can configure prefix, text, colors and gradients.

prefixText.name: Prefix Text
prefixText.description: The text shown before your subtitle.

showPrefix.name: Show UCEssentials
showPrefix.description: Enables or disables the prefix before your subtitle.

prefixColor.name: Prefix Color
prefixColor.description: Select the color for the prefix.

subtitleText.name: Subtitle Text
subtitleText.description: The main text shown below your player name only.

subtitleColor.name: Subtitle Color
subtitleColor.description: Select the text color when no gradient is used.

useGradient.name: Enable Gradient
useGradient.description: Turns the subtitle gradient on or off.

gradientStart.name: Gradient Start
gradientStart.description: The first color used for the gradient.

gradientEnd.name: Gradient End
gradientEnd.description: The second color used for the gradient.

FriendlistNotify.name: Friendlist Notifications
FriendlistNotify.description: Toggles notifications for friendlist changes. If disabled, you will receive the normal chat notification from UnicaCity.

tablistsColors.name: Tablist Colors
tablistsColors.description: Transfers the names and colors from the tablist to the nametags above the players.
